status: Implemented; build, default and Worker validation passed
contract: A byte-level lexical forecast admits decoded text and parsed JSON tree overlap before TextDecoder/JSON.parse. UTF8 input length bounds decoded string payload; punctuation and scalar tokens bound container, property and slot charges. Native JSON.parse validates syntax. Query scope now precedes asynchronous restore and owns parsed trees through query cleanup.

cases: Nested arrays and records, escaped quotes/backslashes, Unicode and own __proto__ key
Exact overlap cap and cap-minus-one rejection
Retained parse output survives scope disposal

remaining: Internal validator row copies and request-compatibility JSON serialization have been removed (linked evidence).
Object state now receives admitted detachment; public standalone deserializers retain their existing unscoped contract.
Spill adapters allocate read buffers before returning them; this interface still lacks pre-read size admission.
Parsed source trees remain charged through query completion even after detached copies become available.
Charges are conservative accounting units, not a portable VM heap guarantee.
